source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 7 exercise solved (PDF 170-173), with the printed numerical answers checked.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Waves and Vibrations) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed response aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain; har numerical step ba step hal hai aur kitab ke jawab se mila kar dekha gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.1 The simple wave speed equation is represented by:
(Wave ki speed ki saada equation kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Crest ek period T mein ek wavelength λ chalta hai, is liye v = λ/T = fλ (Eq. 7.1). Baqi options jism ki speed, circular motion ki linear speed aur average velocity ke formulas hain.

blocks.prompt:
7.2 The principle of superposition in waves is stated as:
(Waves mein superposition ka usool kaise bayan hota hai?)

options.text: wave ka displacement us ke alag alag hisson (components) ke displacements ka majmooa (sum) hai
wave ki velocity us ke components ka product hai
wave ki frequency us ke components ka farq hai
wave ka amplitude us ke components ki ratio hai

blocks.explanation: Jab do ya zyada waves ek particle par ek saath asar karein to resultant displacement alag alag displacements ka algebraic sum hota hai: y = y₁ + y₂ + … + yₙ (7.2).

blocks.prompt:
7.3 A node in a stationary wave is:
(Stationary wave mein node kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Node par resultant displacement hamesha zero hota hai; do nodes ke darmiyan faasla λ/2 hai (7.4).

blocks.prompt:
7.4 An antinode in a stationary wave is:
(Stationary wave mein antinode kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Antinodes sab se bare amplitude (dono waves ke amplitudes ka sum) se vibrate karte hain; yeh do nodes ke beech mein hote hain (7.4).

blocks.prompt:
7.5 Stationary waves are defined as:
(Stationary waves ki taareef kya hai?)

options.text: woh waves jo constant velocity se chalti hain
woh waves jo badalti velocity se chalti hain
woh waves jo ek jagah thehar kar oscillate karti hain
woh waves jo medium mein aage barhti hain

blocks.explanation: Stationary (khari) waves aage nahi barhtin, ek hi jagah oscillate karti hain; nodes aur antinodes apni jagah qaim rehte hain (7.4).

blocks.prompt:
7.6 Harmonics are:
(Harmonics kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Harmonics frequencies f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, …, nf₁ hain, yani fₙ = nf₁ jahan n = 1, 2, 3, … (7.5).

blocks.prompt:
7.7 The result of constructive interference between two waves is represented as:
(Do waves ke constructive interference ka nateeja kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Constructive interference mein crest crest se milta hai (path difference nλ), displacements jama hote hain aur amplitude barh jata hai (7.3).

blocks.prompt:
7.8 If the amplitude of the wave is tripled, then the amount of energy is increased by:
(Agar wave ka amplitude teen guna ho jaye to energy kitni barhegi?)
blocks.explanation: Intensity (energy) ∝ A² (I = kA², Eq. 7.13). Amplitude 3A ho to energy (3)² = 9 guna ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.9 What type of waves do headphones use to produce sound?
(Headphones awaz paida karne ke liye kis qisam ki waves istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Awaz mechanical wave hai: is ko chalne ke liye medium (hawa) chahiye (7.1). Headphone ka diaphragm kaan ke paas hawa ko vibrate karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Options (b), (c) aur (d) teeno awaz par theek baithte hain: hawa mein awaz mechanical wave hai jo longitudinal pressure wave ki shakal mein chalti hai. Chapter (7.1) awaz ko mechanical waves mein ginta hai, is liye mutawaqqa jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.10 The typical frequency range of microwaves is:
(Microwaves ki aam frequency range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Microwaves ki wavelength millimetres se centimetres tak hoti hai (7.7). f = c/λ se: c/(30 cm) = 10⁹ Hz aur c/(3 mm) = 10¹¹ Hz, is liye range taqreeban 10⁹ - 10¹¹ Hz hai. (Kitab mein powers bohat chhoti chhapi hain; inhein 3-5, 5-7, 7-9 aur 9-11 parha gaya hai.)

blocks.prompt:
7.11 The bending of waves around an obstacle is called as:
(Rukawat ke gird waves ke mur jane ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Diffraction rukawat ke kinaron ya konon ke gird waves ka murna, ya gap se guzar kar phail jana hai (7.8).

blocks.prompt:
7.12 The Doppler Effect used in astronomy is for:
(Astronomy mein Doppler effect kis kaam aata hai?)

options.text: black holes ki khususiyat ka jaiza
electromagnetic waves ke rawaiye ka mutala

blocks.explanation: Astronomers sitare ya galaxy ki spectral lines ka red shift ya blue shift naap kar us ki speed nikalte hain (7.12).

blocks.prompt:
7.1 What are the conditions for interference to occur?
Interference hone ki sharait kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Dono sources coherent hon: frequency ek jaisi aur phase difference qaim (constant), jaise ek hi audio generator se chalne wale do speakers.
2. Waves ek hi simt (direction) mein chalte hue aapas mein milein (overlap).
3. Path difference ΔS = nλ ho to constructive, ΔS = (2n + 1)λ/2 ho to destructive interference.

blocks.prompt:
7.2 Differentiate between constructive and destructive interference of waves.
Constructive aur destructive interference mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Constructive mein waves ek doosre ko taqat deti hain; destructive mein ek doosre ko khatam karti hain.

rows: Crest crest se milta hai (compression compression se)
Crest trough se milta hai (compression rarefaction se)
Path difference ΔS = nλ, n = 0, ±1, ±2, …
Path difference ΔS = (2n + 1)λ/2
Amplitude barh jata hai: y = y₁ + y₂
Amplitude kam ho jata hai: y = y₁ − y₂ (y₁ = y₂ ho to zero)
Oonchi awaz (roshni)
Halki ya koi awaz nahi (andhera)

blocks.prompt:
7.3 What are coherent waves and coherent sources? Give examples.
Coherent waves aur coherent sources kya hain? Misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
Coherent waves woh hain jin ki frequency ek jaisi aur phase difference qaim (constant) ho, aam taur par in phase.
Coherent sources woh sources hain jo aisi waves nikalte hain.
Misalein: ek hi audio generator se chalne wale do loudspeakers (7.3); laser ki roshni; ek monochromatic (sodium) lamp se roshan do slits.

blocks.prompt:
7.4 Distinguish between longitudinal and transverse waves.
Longitudinal aur transverse waves mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Farq yeh hai ke particles wave ke chalne ki simt ke muqable mein kis simt mein vibrate karte hain.

rows: Particles wave ki simt ke sath sath (parallel) vibrate karte hain
Particles wave ki simt se 90° par (right angle) vibrate karte hain
Compressions (dabao) aur rarefactions (phailao) se banti hain
Crests (choti) aur troughs (gehrai) se banti hain
Wavelength: do lagatar compressions ka faasla
Wavelength: do lagatar crests ka faasla
Misal: hawa mein awaz
Misal: string par waves, roshni

blocks.prompt:
7.5 Is it possible for two identical waves travelling in the same direction along a string to give rise to a stationary wave? How is it so?
Kya string par ek hi simt mein chalne wali do ek jaisi waves stationary wave bana sakti hain? Kaise?
blocks.explanation:
Nahi. Stationary wave sirf tab banti hai jab do ek jaisi waves (same frequency aur amplitude) mukhalif (opposite) simton mein chalein, jaise incident aur reflected wave (7.4).
Ek hi simt mein chalne wali do waves sirf interfere karti hain aur bare (ya chhote) amplitude wali aage chalti hui wave banati hain, is liye qaim nodes aur antinodes nahi bante.

blocks.prompt:
7.6 How would you apply Doppler effect in studying cardiac problems in humans?
Insaanon mein dil ke masail (cardiac problems) ke mutale mein Doppler effect kaise istemal karein ge?
blocks.explanation:
Doppler echocardiography mein ultrasound dil aur khoon ki nalion mein bheji jati hai. Yeh chalte hue khoon ke cells se takra kar badli hui (Doppler shifted) frequency ke sath wapas aati hai.
Is shift se khoon ke bahao (blood flow) ki speed aur simt maloom hoti hai; is se valve ka tang hona (stenosis) ya ulta bahao (regurgitation) aur band nalian pakri jati hain, cardiac output naapa jata hai aur pacemaker set hota hai (7.12).

blocks.prompt:
7.7 What is meant by diffraction of waves? For what purpose, the ripple tank is used?
Waves ki diffraction se kya muraad hai? Ripple tank kis maqsad ke liye istemal hota hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diffraction rukawat ke tez kinaron ke gird waves ka murna, ya wavelength jitne gap se guzar kar phail jana hai.
Ripple tank paani ki waves banane aur wave ki khususiyat dikhane ke liye hai: reflection, refraction aur diffraction (masalan gap ki chaurai ka diffraction par asar).

blocks.prompt:
7.1 Which measurement of a wave is the most important when determining the wave's intensity?
Wave ki intensity maloom karne ke liye wave ki kaun si measurement sab se ahem hai?
blocks.explanation:
Amplitude.
Mechanical wave ki energy particles ke displacement (amplitude) par munhasir hai, is liye intensity amplitude ke square ke mutanasib (proportional) hai: I ∝ A², I = kA² (7.13).
Is liye amplitude mein thori tabdeeli intensity ko bohat badal deti hai: A do guna to I chaar guna, A teen guna to I nau guna.
(Intensity khud power fi unit area hai, I = P/A, unit W m⁻².)

blocks.prompt:
7.2 Can you apply Doppler effect to light waves? Describe briefly.
Kya Doppler effect roshni ki waves par lagu ho sakta hai? Mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Doppler effect har qisam ki waves par lagu hota hai, electromagnetic (roshni) waves par bhi (7.12).
- Jo sitara ya galaxy Zameen se door ja rahi ho us mein red shift hota hai: spectral lines lambi wavelength ki taraf khisakti hain.
- Jo qareeb aa rahi ho us mein blue shift: chhoti wavelength.
Laboratory source se muqabla kar ke shift naapa jata hai aur speed nikali jati hai, door jane wale source ke liye f′ = [c/(c + uₛ)] f (Example 7.12). Yahi usool radar (hawai jahaz), radar speed trap aur satellite navigation mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.3 Can you compare the compressions and rarefactions of the longitudinal wave with the peaks and troughs of the transverse wave? Discuss.
Kya longitudinal wave ke compressions aur rarefactions ka transverse wave ke peaks (crests) aur troughs se muqabla ho sakta hai? Bahas karein.
blocks.explanation: Haan. Compression (particles ikatthe, pressure zyada) crest (peak) ke barabar hai aur rarefaction (particles phaile hue, pressure kam) trough ke barabar hai. Dono mein do lagatar compressions ya do lagatar crests ka faasla ek wavelength λ hai aur v = fλ lagu hota hai. Farq vibration ki simt ka hai.

rows: Compression: zyada density aur pressure wala hissa
Crest: sab se zyada upar wala displacement
Rarefaction: kam density aur pressure wala hissa
Trough: sab se zyada neeche wala displacement
Particles chalne ki simt mein vibrate karte hain
Particles chalne ki simt se 90° par vibrate karte hain
λ = do lagatar compressions ka faasla
λ = do lagatar crests ka faasla

blocks.prompt:
7.4 How should a source of sound move with respect to an observer so that the frequency of its sound does not change? Write two examples.
Awaz ka source observer ke lihaz se kaise chale ke us ki awaz ki frequency na badle? Do misalein likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Frequency tab nahi badalti jab source aur observer ke darmiyan un ko milane wali line par koi relative motion na ho, yani un ka faasla qaim rahe.
Misalein:
1. Source aur observer ek hi velocity se chalein: chalti car ya train ke musafir us ka horn asal pitch par sunte hain (Example 7.10 mein agar dono trucks ki speed barabar hoti to uₛ = 0 aur f′ = f).
2. Source observer ke gird circle mein ghoome aur observer centre par ho: dori se ghumai gayi seeti ko pakarne wala shakhs us ki pitch ek jaisi sunta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Asal baat faasle ki hai: jab tak source aur sunne wale ka faasla na ghate na barhe, waves na dabti hain na phailti hain, is liye frequency wohi rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.5 Why is it difficult to recognize beats when the frequency difference is greater than 10 Hz? Exemplify.
Jab frequencies ka farq 10 Hz se zyada ho to beats pehchanna kyun mushkil hai? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Beats fi second = frequencies ka farq. Farq 10 Hz se zyada ho to har second 10 se zyada oonchi awazein aati hain, yani ek oonchi awaz pichhli ke 1/10 s se kam waqt mein. Kaan kisi awaz ka asar taqreeban 1/10 s tak rakhta hai (persistence of hearing, chapter se bahar), is liye woh oonchi aur halki awazon ko alag nahi kar pata aur ek musalsal (khurdari) awaz sunta hai (7.9).
Misal: 256 Hz aur 260 Hz ke forks 4 beats/s dete hain jo saaf sunai dete hain; 256 Hz aur 280 Hz 24 beats/s denge jo gine nahi ja sakte.

blocks.prompt:
7.1 State and explain the principle of superposition of waves. Apply this principle to elaborate the working of noise canceling headphones.
Waves ke superposition ka usool bayan aur wazeh karein. Is usool se noise cancelling headphones ka kaam samjhaein.
blocks.explanation:
Superposition ka usool: Agar medium ke kisi particle par do (ya zyada) waves ek waqt mein asar karein to us ka resultant displacement alag alag displacements ka algebraic sum hota hai.
y = y₁ + y₂ + … + yₙ, ya y(x,t) = y₁(x,t) + y₂(x,t) + … + yₙ(x,t)
Wazahat:
(i) Waves in phase (crest par crest): y = y₁ + y₂; agar y₁ = y₂ to y = 2y₁ (taqat barhti hai).
(ii) Waves opposite phase (crest par trough): y = y₁ + (−y₂) = y₁ − y₂; agar y₁ = y₂ to y = 0 (khatam).
Yeh usool linear (chhote amplitude wali) waves par lagu hai aur is se interference (same frequency, same simt), beats (thori mukhtalif frequencies, same simt) aur stationary waves (same frequency, mukhalif simtein) bante hain.
Noise cancelling headphones:
1. Headphones ke microphones aas paas ka shor (baatein, engine ki gharaj) pakarte hain.
2. Signal amplifier aur processing unit ko jata hai.
3. Processor anti-noise signal banata hai: shor jitna amplitude magar ulta (opposite) phase.
4. Anti-noise music ya awaz ke sath speakers se chalaya jata hai.
5. Kaan par shor (y₁) aur anti-noise (−y₁) superpose hote hain: y = y₁ − y₁ = 0, yani destructive interference se shor khatam ho jata hai aur sirf matloob awaz sunai deti hai.
Asal headphones mushkil algorithms aur kai microphones istemal karte hain, magar bunyadi usool superposition hi hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Anti-noise ko aise samjhein: shor ki lehar upar jaye to anti-noise neeche jati hai. Dono jama hon to sifar (zero) bachta hai, is liye shor sunai nahi deta magar music saaf sunai deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.2 What are standing waves? Illustrate a detailed experiment that demonstrates the standing waves using stretched strings.
Standing waves kya hain? Tani hui strings se standing waves dikhane wala tafseeli tajurba bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Standing (stationary) waves: same frequency aur amplitude wali do waves jo mukhalif simton mein chal rahi hon, un ke superposition se banne wali waves. Pattern aage nahi barhta; nodes (zero amplitude) aur antinodes (maximum amplitude) apni jagah qaim rehte hain. Do lagatar nodes ka faasla = λ/2; node se agle antinode tak = λ/4.
Tajurba (tani hui string):
Saman: l lambai ki string jo dono siron se kasi (clamped) ho aur tension F se tani ho; m = mass fi unit length.
(a) Beech se chherne par: do transverse waves dono siron ki taraf jati hain, wahan se reflect ho kar wapas aati hain aur superpose ho kar stationary waves banati hain. Kase hue sire nodes hain aur beech mein ek antinode: string ek loop mein vibrate karti hai.
l = λ₁/2, is liye λ₁ = 2l
String par wave ki speed: v = √(F/m)
f₁ = v/λ₁ = v/2l = (1/2l)√(F/m) (fundamental frequency, pehli harmonic)
(b) Lambai ke chauthai (quarter) hisse se chherne par (antinode ki jagah): string do loops mein vibrate karti hai.
l = λ₂/2 + λ₂/2, is liye λ₂ = l
f₂ = v/λ₂ = v/l = 2(v/2l) = 2f₁ (doosri harmonic)
(c) n loops mein ((n + 1) nodes, n antinodes):
λₙ = 2l/n, fₙ = n(v/2l) = nf₁, n = 1, 2, 3, …
Nataij:
1. String par stationary waves sirf f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, … frequencies (harmonic series) rakhti hain; isay frequencies ki quantization kehte hain. Baqi frequencies jaldi khatam (damp) ho jati hain.
2. Loops barhne se f barhti aur λ ghatti hai, magar fλ = v wohi rehta hai.
3. Frequency tension badal kar (pegs kas kar) ya lambai badal kar (ungliyan hila kar) badli ja sakti hai, jaise guitar aur violin mein.
(Laboratory mein aksar string ko electric vibrator se chalaya jata hai aur pulley par latke weights se tana jata hai; weights ya lambai badalne se 1, 2, 3 … loops nazar aate hain. Yeh set-up chapter se bahar hai.)

blocks.prompt:
7.3 Find the frequencies of the harmonics produced in organ pipe when it is open at one end and when it is open at both ends.
Organ pipe jab ek sire se khula ho aur jab dono siron se khula ho to us mein paida hone wali harmonics ki frequencies maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Organ pipe mein hawa ke column mein stationary longitudinal waves banti hain. Khula sira antinode hota hai (hawa azaadi se hilti hai); band sira node hota hai. Lambai l aur awaz ki speed v hai.
Case 1: Dono siron se khula pipe (dono siron par antinodes)
(a) Fundamental mode: beech mein ek node.
l = λ₁/4 + λ₁/4 = λ₁/2, is liye λ₁ = 2l
f₁ = v/λ₁ = v/2l (fundamental frequency, pehli harmonic)
(b) Doosra mode: teen antinodes, do nodes.
l = λ₂/4 + λ₂/2 + λ₂/4 = λ₂, is liye f₂ = v/l = 2f₁
(c) nth mode: fₙ = n(v/2l) = nf₁, λₙ = 2l/n, n = 1, 2, 3, …
Yani tamam harmonics f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, … maujood hain.
Case 2: Ek sire se band pipe (band sire par node, khule sire par antinode)
(a) Fundamental mode: ek node, ek antinode.
l = λ₁/4, is liye λ₁ = 4l
f₁ = v/λ₁ = v/4l
(b) Agla mode: do nodes, do antinodes.
l = λ₃/4 + λ₃/2 = 3λ₃/4, is liye λ₃ = 4l/3
f₃ = v/λ₃ = 3v/4l = 3f₁ (teesri harmonic)
(c) nth mode: fₙ = n(v/4l) = nf₁, λₙ = 4l/n, n = 1, 3, 5, …
Yani sirf taaq (odd) harmonics f₁, 3f₁, 5f₁, … maujood hain.
Nateeja: dono taraf se khula pipe harmonics mein zyada ameer hai; same lambai par us ki fundamental (v/2l) band pipe (v/4l) se do guna hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: khula sira = antinode (A), band sira = node (N). N se A tak ka faasla hamesha λ/4 hai. Band pipe mein ek sire par N aur doosre par A hai, is liye lambai λ/4, 3λ/4, 5λ/4 … hi ho sakti hai; is liye sirf odd harmonics aati hain.

blocks.prompt:
7.4 Define and exemplify diffraction of waves. Describe this phenomenon by ripple tank experiment.
Waves ki diffraction ki taareef aur misalein dein. Ripple tank ke tajurbe se is ko bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Taareef: Diffraction rukawat ke tez kinaron ya konon ke gird waves ka murna, ya barrier ke peeche waves ka phail jana hai. Yeh tab hoti hai jab rukawat ya surakh (slit) ka size wavelength ke barabar ho. Wavelength jitni lambi, phailao utna zyada.
Yeh har qisam ki waves mein hoti hai: paani, awaz, roshni aur doosri electromagnetic waves.
Misalein:
1. Hum kone ke peeche ya darwaze se awaz sun lete hain kyunke awaz ki waves kone ke gird mur jati hain.
2. Crystals X-rays ko diffract karte hain kyunke atoms ka darmiyani faasla X-rays ki wavelength jitna hai.
3. Bareek diffraction grating safed roshni ko rangon mein baant deti hai; CD ki bareek lakeerein grating ka kaam karti hain.
Ripple tank ka tajurba:
Saman: paani ka tank, vibrator (motor wali hilti sui ya patti), rukawatein (chhota rectangular block ya semicircular barrier) jin se mukhtalif chaurai ke gaps banaye jate hain.
Tareeqa:
1. Vibrator seedhi (parallel) ya gol (circular) paani ki waves banata hai.
2. Raaste mein do rukawatein rakh kar ek khaas chaurai ka gap chhora jata hai.
3. Gap se guzarne wali waves ka pattern dekha jata hai; mukhtalif gaps ke sath tajurba dohraya jata hai.
Mushahidat:
- Gap wavelength ke muqable mein chhota ho to diffraction zyada: waves kinaron ke gird mur kar semicircular shakal mein phail jati hain.
- Gap wavelength ke muqable mein chaura ho to diffraction kam: waves seedhi guzar jati hain aur kam murti hain.
Nateeja: diffraction ki miqdar gap ki chaurai aur wavelength ki nisbat (ratio) par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.5 What is meant by the term beats? Prove that number of beats per second is equal to the difference between the frequencies of vibrating tuning forks.
Beats se kya muraad hai? Sabit karein ke beats fi second ki tadaad vibrate karte tuning forks ki frequencies ke farq ke barabar hai.
blocks.explanation:
Beats: Jab thori si mukhtalif frequencies wali do awaz ki waves ek hi simt mein chalte hue milti hain to awaz ki oonchai baqaida waqfon se maximum aur minimum ke darmiyan ghatti barhti hai. Is tabdeeli ko beats kehte hain.
Saboot (kitab ki misal):
Tuning fork A ki fA = 32 Hz aur fork B (wax laga hua) ki fB = 28 Hz hai; dono ek saath bajaye jate hain.
- Waqt X par dono waves ka displacement ek hi simt mein hai: resultant bara, oonchi awaz.
- 1/8 s mein A 4 vibrations aur B 3.5 vibrations karta hai, yani A aadhi vibration aage: Y par displacements ulte, halki ya koi awaz nahi.
- Mazeed 1/8 s mein (X se 1/4 s baad) A poori ek vibration aage ho jata hai: Z par waves phir ek saath, oonchi awaz.
Yani har 1/4 s baad ek oonchi awaz, yani 4 beats fi second, aur fA − fB = 32 − 28 = 4 Hz.
Aam saboot: Do lagatar oonchi awazon ka darmiyani waqt T ho. Is waqt mein fork A, fork B se ek vibration zyada karta hai (poori ek vibration aage nikal jata hai), is liye
fA T − fB T = 1
fA − fB = 1/T
Beats fi second f_beat = 1/T hain, lehaza
f_beat = fA − fB
Yani beats fi second dono tuning forks ki frequencies ke farq ke barabar hain.
(Beats se saaz tune kiye jate hain: string ko itna kasa ya dheela kiya jata hai ke standard note ke sath beats khatam ho jayein. Farq taqreeban 10 Hz se zyada ho to beats pehchane nahi jate.)

blocks.prompt:
7.6 What do you understand by progressive waves? Discuss the intensity of progressive waves.
Progressive waves se aap kya samajhte hain? Progressive waves ki intensity par bahas karein.
blocks.explanation:
Progressive waves: Progressive (chalti hui) wave medium mein ek khaas simt mein chalti hai aur energy ek jagah se doosri jagah le jati hai, stationary wave ke ulat. Misalein: paani ki waves, awaz, roshni.
Intensity: progressive wave ke chalne ki simt mein fi unit area fi unit time guzarne wali energy. Yeh wave ki power ka paimana hai; nishan I, unit W m⁻².
I = E/(A × t) = (E/t)/A
I = P/A (kyunke E/t = P, power)
jahan E = energy (J), t = waqt (s), A = area (m²), P = power (W).
Amplitude par inhesar: Mechanical waves mein energy particles ki kinetic aur potential energy ki shakal mein hoti hai jo un ke mean position se displacement (amplitude) par munhasir hai. Is liye
I ∝ A², ya I = kA² (7.13)
jahan k wave aur medium par munhasir constant hai. Amplitude do guna to intensity chaar guna.
Faasle par inhesar: Point source jo power P har taraf barabar phailaye, us ki energy 4πr² area ke sphere par phailti hai, is liye I = P/(4πr²) (Example 7.8); intensity 1/r² ke hisaab se ghatti hai.
Note: frequency aur amplitude alag cheezein hain; volume (amplitude, intensity) barhane se pitch (frequency) nahi badalti.

blocks.prompt:
7.7 Keeping in mind "Doppler effect", analyze the following cases:
(a) when source of sound moves away from the stationary observer.
(b) when source of sound moves towards the stationary observer
"Doppler effect" ko zehen mein rakhte hue in surton ka jaiza lein: (a) jab awaz ka source thehre hue observer se door ja raha ho; (b) jab source thehre hue observer ki taraf aa raha ho.
blocks.explanation:
Doppler effect: source aur observer ki relative motion ki wajah se waves ki frequency (pitch) mein zahiri (apparent) tabdeeli.
Thehra hua source frequency f aur wavelength λ ki waves nikalta hai; awaz ki speed v, to f = v/λ. Source speed uₛ se chale to ek second mein uₛ faasla tay karta hai, is liye har wavelength Doppler shift Δλ = uₛ/f se badal jati hai.
(a) Source thehre hue observer D se door ja raha ho:
Waves khinch (phail) jati hain:
λ_D = λ + Δλ = v/f + uₛ/f = (v + uₛ)/f
Zahiri frequency:
f_D = v/λ_D = [v/(v + uₛ)] f
Kyunke v/(v + uₛ) < 1, f_D < f: observer ko frequency aur pitch kam sunai deti hai.
Misal: platform se door jate engine ki seeti neechi (bhari) lagti hai.
(b) Source thehre hue observer C ki taraf aa raha ho:
Waves dab (compress) jati hain:
λ_C = λ − Δλ = v/f − uₛ/f = (v − uₛ)/f
Zahiri frequency:
f_C = v/λ_C = [v/(v − uₛ)] f
Kyunke v/(v − uₛ) > 1, f_C > f: frequency aur pitch barh jati hai.
Misal: platform ki taraf aate engine ki seeti oonchi (bareek) lagti hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.1 The speed of a wave on a typical string is 24 m s⁻¹. What driving frequency will it resonate if its length is 6.0 m? (Ans: 2 Hz)
Ek string par wave ki speed 24 m s⁻¹ hai. Agar us ki lambai 6.0 m ho to woh kis driving frequency par resonate karegi?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: v = 24 m s⁻¹, l = 6.0 m
Maloom karna: fundamental (sab se kam resonant) frequency f₁ = ?
Formula: f₁ = v/2l (string ek loop mein, λ₁ = 2l)
Qeemat dalne par: f₁ = 24 m s⁻¹ / (2 × 6.0 m)
f₁ = 24/12 s⁻¹
Jawab: f₁ = 2 Hz (is ki harmonics 4 Hz, 6 Hz, … par bhi resonance hogi). Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.2 The lowest resonance frequency for a guitar string of length 0.75 m is 400 Hz. Calculate the speed of a transverse wave on the string. (Ans: 600 m s⁻¹)
0.75 m lambi guitar string ki sab se kam resonance frequency 400 Hz hai. String par transverse wave ki speed maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: l = 0.75 m, f₁ = 400 Hz
Maloom karna: v = ?
Formula: f₁ = v/2l, is liye v = 2lf₁
Qeemat dalne par: v = 2 × 0.75 m × 400 Hz
v = 1.5 × 400 m s⁻¹
Jawab: v = 600 m s⁻¹. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.3 A tuning fork A produces 4 beats per second with another tuning fork B. It is found that by loading B with some wax, the beat frequency increases to 6 beats per second. If the frequency of A is 320 Hz, determine the frequency of B when loaded. (Ans: 314 Hz)
Tuning fork A, fork B ke sath 4 beats fi second deta hai. B par wax lagane se beats 6 fi second ho jate hain. Agar A ki frequency 320 Hz ho to wax lage B ki frequency maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: fA = 320 Hz, wax se pehle beats n = 4 s⁻¹, B par wax ke baad beats = 6 s⁻¹
Maloom karna: wax lage B ki frequency = ?
Formula: fA − fB = ±n, is liye fB = fA ± n
Wax se pehle: fB = 320 ± 4 = 324 Hz ya 316 Hz
B par wax lagane se us ki frequency kam hoti hai.
- Agar fB = 324 Hz ho to kam hone par 320 Hz ke qareeb aayegi aur beats ghatenge. Mumkin nahi.
- Agar fB = 316 Hz ho to kam hone par 320 Hz se mazeed door hogi aur beats barhenge. Sahi.
Is liye asal fB = 316 Hz. Wax ke baad beats = 6:
fB(loaded) = fA − 6 = 320 − 6
Jawab: wax lage B ki frequency = 314 Hz. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Wax (mom) lagane se fork bhari ho jata hai aur dheere vibrate karta hai, yani frequency kam hoti hai. Isi se faisla hota hai ke B ki frequency A se kam thi ya zyada.

blocks.prompt:
7.4 A steel wire hangs vertically from a fixed point, supporting a weight of 80 N at its lower end. The diameter of the wire is 0.50 mm and its length from the fixed point to the weight is 1.5 m. Calculate the fundamental frequency emitted by the wire when it is plucked. Density of steel wire is 7.8 x 10³ kg m⁻³. (Ans: 76.2 Hz)
Steel ki taar ek fixed point se latki hai aur neeche 80 N ka wazan uthaye hue hai. Taar ka diameter 0.50 mm aur lambai 1.5 m hai. Chherne par taar ki fundamental frequency maloom karein. Steel ki density 7.8 × 10³ kg m⁻³ hai.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: tension F = 80 N, diameter d = 0.50 mm, is liye radius r = 0.25 mm = 0.25 × 10⁻³ m, l = 1.5 m, ρ = 7.8 × 10³ kg m⁻³
Maloom karna: f₁ = ?
Formulas: m = mass fi unit length = ρ × (cross-sectional area) = ρπr²; v = √(F/m); f₁ = v/2l
Step 1: area = πr² = 3.14 × (0.25 × 10⁻³ m)² = 1.96 × 10⁻⁷ m²
Step 2: m = 7.8 × 10³ kg m⁻³ × 1.96 × 10⁻⁷ m² = 1.53 × 10⁻³ kg m⁻¹
Step 3: v = √(80 N / 1.53 × 10⁻³ kg m⁻¹) = √(5.22 × 10⁴) m s⁻¹ = 228.6 m s⁻¹
Step 4: f₁ = v/2l = 228.6 / (2 × 1.5) = 228.6/3
Jawab: f₁ ≈ 76.2 Hz. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Wazan (80 N) hi taar ka tension F hai. Mass fi unit length m nikalne ke liye density ko taar ke cross-section ke area (πr²) se zarb dein; diameter ko pehle aadha kar ke radius banana na bhoolein aur mm ko m mein badlein.

blocks.prompt:
7.5 Average intensity of sunlight on the surface of the Earth is nearly 500 W m⁻². Determine the amount of energy that falls on a solar panel having an area of 0.50 m² in four hours. (Ans: 3.6 x 10⁶ J)
Zameen ki satah par dhoop ki average intensity taqreeban 500 W m⁻² hai. 0.50 m² area ke solar panel par chaar ghanton mein girne wali energy maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: I = 500 W m⁻², A = 0.50 m², t = 4 h = 4 × 3600 s = 14400 s
Maloom karna: E = ?
Formula: I = E/(A × t), is liye E = I × A × t
Qeemat dalne par: E = 500 W m⁻² × 0.50 m² × 14400 s
E = 250 W × 14400 s = 3600000 J
Jawab: E = 3.6 × 10⁶ J. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.6 (a) If the intensity of a wave is 16 W m⁻² and the amplitude is 2 m, what is the value of constant k? (Ans: 4 W m⁻⁴)
(b) If the intensity of a wave is 25 W m⁻² and the constant k is 5 W m⁻⁴, what is the amplitude? (Ans: 2.24 m)
(a) Wave ki intensity 16 W m⁻² aur amplitude 2 m ho to constant k ki qeemat kya hai? (b) Intensity 25 W m⁻² aur k = 5 W m⁻⁴ ho to amplitude kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Formula: I = kA² (7.13)
(a) Diya gaya: I = 16 W m⁻², A = 2 m. Maloom karna: k = ?
k = I/A² = 16 W m⁻² / (2 m)² = 16/4 W m⁻⁴
k = 4 W m⁻⁴. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.
(b) Diya gaya: I = 25 W m⁻², k = 5 W m⁻⁴. Maloom karna: A = ?
A² = I/k = 25 W m⁻² / 5 W m⁻⁴ = 5 m²
A = √5 m
A = 2.24 m. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.7 (a) A sound system produces 200 watts of power. If the sound is directed at a crowd with an area of 150 m², what is the intensity of the sound? (Ans: 1.33 W m⁻²)
(b) A light bulb emits 100 watts of power. If the light is spread out evenly over a sphere with a surface area of 400 m², what is the intensity of the light? (Ans: 0.25 W m⁻²)
(a) Sound system 200 W power deta hai. Awaz 150 m² area ke hujoom par dali jaye to intensity kya hai? (b) Bulb 100 W power deta hai jo 400 m² satah wale sphere par barabar phailti hai; intensity kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Formula: I = P/A
(a) Diya gaya: P = 200 W, A = 150 m². Maloom karna: I = ?
I = 200 W / 150 m²
I = 1.33 W m⁻². Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.
(b) Diya gaya: P = 100 W, A = 400 m². Maloom karna: I = ?
I = 100 W / 400 m²
I = 0.25 W m⁻². Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.8 A radio antenna broadcasts 500 watts of power. If the signal is received at a distance of 10 km, what is the intensity of the signal? (Ans: 4 x 10⁻⁷ W m⁻²)
Radio antenna 500 W power nashar karta hai. Signal 10 km door wusool ho to us ki intensity kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: P = 500 W, r = 10 km = 1.0 × 10⁴ m
Maloom karna: I = ?
Power r radius ke sphere (area 4πr²) par barabar phailti hai.
Formula: I = P/(4πr²)
Qeemat dalne par: I = 500 W / (4 × 3.14 × (1.0 × 10⁴ m)²)
I = 500 / (12.56 × 10⁸) W m⁻²
I = 3.98 × 10⁻⁷ W m⁻²
Jawab: I ≈ 4 × 10⁻⁷ W m⁻². Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.9 An organ pipe has a length of 1 m. Determine the frequencies of the fundamental and the first two harmonics:
(a) if the pipe is open at both ends and (b) if the pipe is closed at one end.
(Speed of sound in air is 340 m s⁻¹)
(Ans: 170 Hz, 340 Hz, 510 Hz; 85 Hz, 255 Hz, 425 Hz respectively)
Organ pipe ki lambai 1 m hai. Fundamental aur agli do harmonics ki frequencies maloom karein: (a) pipe dono siron se khula ho, (b) pipe ek sire se band ho. (Hawa mein awaz ki speed 340 m s⁻¹)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: l = 1 m, v = 340 m s⁻¹
(a) Dono siron se khula pipe: fₙ = n(v/2l), n = 1, 2, 3, …
f₁ = 340 / (2 × 1) = 170 Hz
f₂ = 2f₁ = 340 Hz
f₃ = 3f₁ = 510 Hz
(b) Ek sire se band pipe: fₙ = n(v/4l), n = 1, 3, 5, … (sirf odd harmonics)
f₁ = 340 / (4 × 1) = 85 Hz
f₃ = 3f₁ = 255 Hz
f₅ = 5f₁ = 425 Hz
Jawab: (a) 170 Hz, 340 Hz, 510 Hz; (b) 85 Hz, 255 Hz, 425 Hz. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Band pipe mein 2f₁ aur 4f₁ nahi bante, is liye fundamental ke baad agli do frequencies 3f₁ aur 5f₁ hain.

blocks.prompt:
7.10 A train is approaching a station at 90 km h⁻¹, sounding a whistle of frequency 1000 Hz. What will be the apparent frequency of the whistle as heard by a listener sitting on the platform? What will be the apparent frequency heard by the same listener if the train moves away from the station with the same speed? (Speed of sound is 340 m s⁻¹) (Ans: 1079.4 Hz, 931.5 Hz respectively)
Train 90 km h⁻¹ se station ki taraf aa rahi hai aur 1000 Hz ki seeti baja rahi hai. Platform par baithe shakhs ko seeti ki zahiri frequency kya sunai degi? Agar train isi speed se station se door jaye to kya frequency sunai degi? (Awaz ki speed 340 m s⁻¹)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: uₛ = 90 km h⁻¹ = 90 × 1000 m / 3600 s = 25 m s⁻¹, f = 1000 Hz, v = 340 m s⁻¹
Maloom karna: f′ (qareeb aate hue) aur f′ (door jate hue)
(i) Train qareeb aa rahi: f′ = [v/(v − uₛ)] f
f′ = [340/(340 − 25)] × 1000 = (340/315) × 1000
f′ = 1079.4 Hz
(ii) Train door ja rahi: f′ = [v/(v + uₛ)] f
f′ = [340/(340 + 25)] × 1000 = (340/365) × 1000
f′ = 931.5 Hz
Jawab: bil-tarteeb 1079.4 Hz aur 931.5 Hz. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Pehle speed ko km h⁻¹ se m s⁻¹ mein badlein (90 ÷ 3.6 = 25). Qareeb aaye to neeche minus (v − uₛ), frequency barhti hai; door jaye to plus (v + uₛ), frequency ghatti hai.

Numericals: tamam das ke jawab kitab ke chhape jawabon se milte hain.
